versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart E — Power-Plant Installations; Reciprocating Engines
versions.title_at_revision: Oil system lines, fittings, and accessories.
versions.text: Oil lines shall comply with the provisions of § 3.550, except that the inside diameter of the engine oil inlet and outlet lines shall not be less than the diameter of the corresponding engine oil pump inlet and outlet.
